sources.note: Main Qualifacts homepage. Describes company as behavioral health EHR provider serving 2,700+ agencies across all 50 states. Lists three platforms: CareLogic, Credible, InSync. Describes AI-powered EHRs, client engagement, care management, billing, and analytics capabilities.

InSync product page. Describes it as fully integrated cloud-based EHR with charting, billing, scheduling, telehealth. Details e-prescription, eMAR, automated claims, ASAM support. Notes AWS hosting, 99% uptime, MVC technology. Target: small to mid-market behavioral health.

Qualifacts About page. Describes three platforms (Credible for enterprise, CareLogic for multi-site, InSync for small/mid-size). Credible is #1 in KLAS for Behavioral Health. Nashville/Tampa HQ with global staff. No specific customer/employee counts provided.

Care management features page. Describes assessments library, treatment planning, AI clinical documentation (Qualifacts iQ converting transcripts to DAP/BIRP/Progress Notes), ePrescribing with PDMP/EPCS/eMAR, customizable dashboards, role-based access.

Client portal features page. Portal enables form completion, record access, telehealth, appointment reminders, broadcast messaging, eSignature, direct payments with real-time balances, branded interface, mobile app.
ONC mandatory disclosures PDF for InSync. Could not extract readable text from the PDF format.

December 2021 acquisition announcement. InSync described as leading EHR/PM provider for behavioral, medical, and rehabilitative professionals. Combined company serves 10M+ patients in all 50 states. Acquisition doubled customer count. InSync targeted organizations <50 FTEs.

Third-party EHR review site. Lists features: appointment management, billing, clinical workflow, document management, EM coding, insurance/claims, lab integration, medical templates, patient demographics, patient portals, referrals, reporting, scheduling, voice recognition, e-prescription. Supports HL7 and ICD-10.

TechRadar review giving 2/5 stars. Notes behavioral health focus, robust patient portal, multiple support options, training resources. Criticizes lack of pricing transparency, no free trial, no mobile app.

EMR review site. Describes InSync as all-in-one cloud-based EMR/PM with integrated patient portal, medical billing, telehealth. Notes ePrescribing, eMAR, automated claims, scheduling with multi-provider views, text/phone/email reminders.
Software Finder listing for InSync. Lists features and pricing information. Confirms behavioral health, SUD, and rehabilitative therapy focus.
Case study of KindMind, a Michigan mental health practice that scaled using InSync. Referenced as example of InSync's mental health EMR capabilities in practice.
InSync overview fact sheet PDF. Could not extract readable text from the PDF format.
Solo practice marketing page. References add-on capabilities and configurability for solo practitioners.
